## Migration Notes

- `api-gateway` and `dashboard` are the core unified services started by `scripts/launch/launch-all.ps1`.
  - Dashboard: `http://localhost:3000`  |  API Gateway: `http://localhost:4000`
- Migrated projects live under `services/<service-name>` and are registered as proxy
  routes in `apps/api-gateway/index.js`.
- Projects with `.git` history are copied with history preserved (read-only on the source).
- Use `scripts/migrate/migrate-project.ps1` (single) or `migrate-all.ps1` (batch) to migrate
  discovered projects into the monorepo.
- Ports: dashboard = 3000, api-gateway = 4000, migrated services = 4001+.
- Stop the stack with `scripts/launch/stop-all.ps1`.
